adjustments.description: Sum of the adjustments, positive or negative

gamesInPlay.description: Games without a result yet; informative

gamesNet.description: Net of the games, those in play included (their buy-in is already spent)

investedInPlay.description: Money paid for the entries of the games in play; already subtracted in gamesNet

result.description: Won or lost playing: gamesNet + bonuses

ticketsWon.description: Value of the tickets won; informative, not part of the bankroll

rooms.description: Rooms that are active or have games or movements, by name

total.description: The rooms in this currency plus the movements without a room

withoutRoom.description: Movements that belong to no room; they only count in the total

groups.description: Groups with finished games. Periods from oldest to newest, buy-ins from lowest to highest, anything else from most to fewest games

byGameType.description: The game types with finished games, in catalog order

total.description: Every finished game in this currency

bounty.description: Bounties won. Not for cash games. Defaults to 0

prize.description: Cash won, bounties apart. Cash game: amount when leaving the table. Defaults to 0

ticketPrizeValue.description: Value of a tournament ticket won. Not for cash games. Defaults to 0

buyIn.description: Price of one entry, also when it was paid with a ticket. Cash game: amount brought to the table

paidWithTicket.description: One entry was paid with a ticket instead of cash. Defaults to false

playedAt.description: Optional local start time (HH:mm), to order the games of a day

prize.description: Cash won, bounties apart. Cash game: amount when leaving the table. Defaults to 0

status.description: IN_PLAY (registered when it starts, no result yet) or FINISHED. When omitted: FINISHED if a result is sent (prize, bounty or ticket); otherwise IN_PLAY for a new game and unchanged for an existing one

ticketPrizeValue.description: Value of a tournament ticket won as a prize; informative, not part of net. Defaults to 0

variantId.description: Optional; must be a variant of the game type

currencyCode.description: Currency of every amount of this game (the one of its room)

invested.description: Money paid for the entries (an entry paid with a ticket costs nothing)

net.description: Real money won or lost: prize + bounty - invested

status.description: IN_PLAY while the result is not known yet; its buy-in already counts in net

cumulativeNet.description: Net of this period and the earlier ones in the response, so it starts from zero at the beginning of the filtered range; only for groups in time

gameType.description: GAME_TYPE, and VARIANT (the type the variant belongs to)

variant.description: VARIANT; null for the games of the type without a variant

invested.description: Money paid so far for their entries

amount.description: Greater than zero: the type gives the direction (a withdrawal subtracts). Only an ADJUSTMENT can be negative

currencyCode.description: Only for a movement without a room, e.g. EUR

roomId.description: Room the movement belongs to; the amount is in its currency. Omit it, and give a currency, for a movement of the bankroll as a whole

currencyCode.description: Currency of the amount: the one of the room, or its own without a room

room.description: Null for a movement of the bankroll as a whole

signedAmount.description: Effect on the bankroll: the amount, negative for a withdrawal

amount.description: Amount added to the buy-in of the game

active.description: Inactive rooms keep their history but are not offered for new games. Defaults to true.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code of one of the currencies of the catalog

inUse.description: The room has games or bankroll movements: it cannot be deleted and its currency cannot change

averageBuyIn.description: Mean buy-in of a game; cash games apart

gamesInTheMoney.description: Games with a prize or a ticket won (bounties do not count); cash games apart

gamesWithPrize.description: Games with a prize, a bounty or a ticket won; cash games apart

invested.description: Money paid for the entries (an entry paid with a ticket costs nothing)

roi.description: net / invested; null when nothing was invested

ticketsWon.description: Value of the tickets won; informative, not part of won, net or roi

code.description: Code of a built-in variant, translated by the client; null for user-defined ones

inUse.description: The variant is used by games: it cannot be deleted

name.description: Name of a user-defined variant; null for built-in ones

active.description: Inactive variants keep their history but are not offered for new games

name.description: New name of a user-defined variant. Must be omitted (or null) for built-in variants.
